user.title: Connect Thuisbord
user.description:
This integration sends your smart meter's readings to Thuisbord, so every screen in your home can show them. It reads only the sensors you choose and controls no devices.

You get the key in the Thuisbord app: Settings › Meter connection › Connect meter › Home Assistant. After I agree, it shows once under Your connection key: tap Copy and paste it here. Lost it? Make a new one in the app under Meter connection with Make a new key.

data_description.connection_key: Starts with thb_. Home Assistant keeps the key only in this integration and never writes it to the log.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only needed to test with your own Thuisbord server.

consent.title: Key works, no consent yet
consent.description: Thuisbord knows this key, but you have not yet said which values Thuisbord may receive. In the Thuisbord app, tap **I agree**, then click Submit here.

mode.title: How do the readings reach Thuisbord?
mode.description: The key works. Choose how Home Assistant sends readings.

menu_options.sensors: I choose my sensors, Thuisbord reads them itself
menu_options.action: I make my own automation with the action

sensors.title: Choose your sensors
sensors.description: Only power is needed. Choose only what your meter reports; Thuisbord sends at most one reading every 10 seconds, with only the values you choose here.

power_section.name: Power (required)
power_section.description: Choose one net power sensor, or an import and an export sensor. W and kW are both understood.

data_description.power: Positive when importing, negative when exporting, as HomeWizard reports it. When chosen, leave the two fields below empty.
data_description.power_import: What you take from the grid now, always positive, such as DSMR Power consumption.
data_description.power_export: What you send to the grid now, as a positive number, such as DSMR Power production.

totals_section.name: Meter totals and tariff (optional)
totals_section.description: Tariff 1 and tariff 2 go together: choose both or neither. Without totals, Thuisbord works out your use from power; without the tariff, it uses your low-tariff hours. Wh, kWh and MWh are all understood.

data_description.import_total: Import of both tariffs together, for a meter that reports no totals per tariff.
data_description.active_tariff: A sensor reporting 1 or 2, or low or normal, as DSMR does.

extra_section.name: Solar and gas (optional)
extra_section.description: Not chosen, or unknown for now? Then the field is left out of the reading.

data_description.solar_power: W or kW. A negative value becomes 0.

action.title: Make your own automation
action.description: Home Assistant then reads no sensors itself. Make an automation that calls the action **Thuisbord: Send reading** with your power and, if you like, meter totals, tariff, solar and gas. Thuisbord takes at most one reading every 10 seconds; an earlier one is skipped.

reauth_confirm.title: New connection key needed
reauth_confirm.description: Thuisbord no longer takes readings with the saved key. Paste your new connection key. If you don't have one, make one in the Thuisbord app under Settings › Meter connection with Make a new key. If the meter was disconnected, connect it again under Connect meter › Home Assistant and paste the key you get then.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection key
reconfigure.description: Paste your new connection key. In the Thuisbord app you make one under Settings › Meter connection with Make a new key.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only needed to test with your own Thuisbord server.

error.invalid_key_format: This is not a Thuisbord connection key: that starts with thb_ and is long. Paste the whole key. If you no longer have it, make a new one in the Thuisbord app with Make a new key.
error.invalid_url: This server address is not right. Use {default_url}.
error.insecure_url: The server address must start with https://, because the key goes there. Only a server in your home or on this computer may use http://.
error.invalid_key: Thuisbord does not know this connection key. Check that you pasted the whole key. If you no longer have it, make a new one in the Thuisbord app under Meter connection with Make a new key.
error.key_revoked: This key no longer works: a new one was made in the Thuisbord app, or the meter was disconnected. Paste the new key. If the meter was disconnected, connect it again in the app.
error.consent_not_recorded: You have not given consent yet. In the Thuisbord app, under Settings › Meter connection, tap Connect meter, choose Home Assistant and tap I agree; if you see There's already a connection key, tap Keep the current key. Then paste the key here again.
error.token_not_allowed: This is another key than the connection key. Use the key the Thuisbord app showed under Your connection key, or make a new one with Make a new key.
error.key_refused: Thuisbord refuses this key. Paste the whole key again, or make a new one in the Thuisbord app with Make a new key.
error.too_many_requests: Thuisbord asks you to wait a moment. Try again in a minute.
error.unexpected_response: Thuisbord gave an answer this integration does not know. Update the integration in HACS.
error.cannot_connect: Thuisbord cannot be reached. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
error.power_required: Choose a net power sensor, or an import and an export power sensor.
error.power_pair_incomplete: For power, choose both import and export, or one net power sensor.
error.pair_incomplete: Tariff 1 and tariff 2 go together. Choose both or neither ({entity_id}).
error.unsupported_unit: {entity_id} has a unit Thuisbord does not know. Choose a sensor in W or kW, Wh, kWh or MWh, or m³ or litres for gas.
error.consent_still_missing: No consent in the Thuisbord app yet. Tap I agree there and try again.

abort.wrong_household: This key belongs to another household. Add that household separately.
abort.reauth_successful: The new key works. Home Assistant sends readings again.

reads_sensors.message: This Thuisbord connection reads your sensors itself. To send readings yourself, choose the action in the integration's options.

reading_out_of_range.message: {field} has a value Thuisbord does not take.

reading_tariff_pair_incomplete.message: {field} is missing. Totals per tariff go in pairs: send both, or neither.

sending_stopped.message: Thuisbord takes no readings with this key. Paste the new key under Settings › Devices & services › Thuisbord.

sensor_missing.title: Thuisbord: sensor no longer exists
sensor_missing.description: {title} uses {entity_id}, but that sensor no longer exists. Choose another sensor in the Thuisbord integration's options.

sensor_unit.title: Thuisbord: unit not understood
sensor_unit.description: {entity_id} has a unit Thuisbord does not know, so this value is left out. Use W or kW, Wh, kWh or MWh, or m³ or litres for gas, or choose another sensor in the Thuisbord integration's options.

sensor_out_of_range.title: Thuisbord: impossible value
sensor_out_of_range.description: {entity_id} reports a value no meter can report, so this value is left out. Check that you chose the right sensor in the Thuisbord integration's options.

sensor_unknown_value.title: Thuisbord: tariff not understood
sensor_unknown_value.description: {entity_id} reports no tariff 1 or 2, nor low or normal. Until it does, Thuisbord uses your low-tariff hours. Choose another sensor in the Thuisbord integration's options, or leave Active tariff empty.

send_reading.name: Send reading
send_reading.description: Sends one reading to Thuisbord. Only power is required. Thuisbord takes at most one reading every 10 seconds; an earlier one is skipped.

config_entry_id.name: Thuisbord connection
config_entry_id.description: The household that gets the reading.
